title: Spiced Courgette Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Indian-inspired dish made with stir-fried courgette and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 1-2 seconds.
Add the courgette and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add the coriander powder, garam masala, and salt. Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve hot with naan or rice, if desired.
